title: fix(console-ai): a message sent while an image or PDF uploads waits behind the turn that carries it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9R6fQuMSzSrRW2oowG4K2kQ)_

Fixes #34462

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台「问 AI」聊天里，带图片或 PDF 的那条消息要等上传完才发出；现在上传期间又发的消息会排在它后面，按用户发送的顺序到达 agent；上传期间输入框显示忙碌，新打的字会像回复进行中那样排队。
- 为什么改：以前不带附件的消息立刻发出，带附件的要等几秒上传，后发的一句会先到 agent，agent 在看到文件之前就先回答了（#34459 引入）。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `AiChatPage.tsx` 的发送路径和传给对话面板的 `isLoading`；上传期间面板显示「思考中」、计划卡按钮暂时锁住，上传结束（成功或失败）即恢复。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` 的 `doSend` / `prepareTurn`（发送链与忙碌计数）；同文件 `ChatbotEnhanced` 的 `isLoading={isLoading || preparingTurn}`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.sendOrderWhileUploading-34462.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, the console AI chat's send path:

- **Turns go out in the order sent.** `doSend` used to call `sendMessage` at once for a turn with no attachment, but only after `uploadChatAttachments` (or the spreadsheet parse) settled for a turn with one. A turn sent in between overtook it. Now every turn that has attachments, or that is sent while an earlier turn is still being prepared, joins a send chain (`sendChainRef`): its attachments are read at once (two turns' uploads overlap), and its `sendMessage` waits for the turn ahead of it. A turn with no attachment and nothing ahead of it still sends synchronously, exactly as before.
- **Busy while a turn is prepared.** A counter of turns being prepared drives `preparingTurn`, which is folded into the `isLoading` the page hands `ChatbotEnhanced`. The composer already queues a message typed during a running reply (#32984: shown above the composer, sent when the turn ends), so a message typed during an upload now queues there too and is sent after the uploading turn and its reply. The page's own `isLoading` (canvas refresh, package binding, the Stop handler) is unchanged.
- **Failure releases it.** The counter is decremented in a `finally`, so an upload failure (named in the turn as not read, as before) or any other failure in preparing a turn releases the busy state; a failing turn does not hold the chain either.
- The attachment reading (spreadsheet brief, uploads, notes) moved unchanged from `doSend` / `sendNonSheetAttachments` into one `prepareTurn`; `onSent` is told the same text as before (the sheet brief, not the file notes).

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.sendOrderWhileUploading-34462.test.tsx`, on the same real subjects as the #32749 test (real `ChatPane` send path, real `useChatConversation`, real `useObjectChat` transport, `fetch` stub capturing the chat POSTs, a recorder for `ChatbotEnhanced`, an upload adapter the test settles by hand):

1. a turn sent while an earlier turn's photo is still uploading is not POSTed until the upload settles, and then goes out after that turn; the composer's `isLoading` is true during the upload and false after;
2. an upload that fails releases the busy state, and the turn still sends naming the file as not read;
3. CONTROL: a turn with no attachment sends at once and uploads nothing.

<details><summary>Runs (head 53a363bc, before the main merge, which touched no file here)</summary>

```
vitest run …sendOrderWhileUploading-34462.test.tsx …attachmentsUpload-32749.test.tsx
  Tests  8 passed (8) · VERDICT command-exit 0
vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/
  Test Files  56 passed (56) · Tests  360 passed (360) · VERDICT command-exit 0
```

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (mutation on disk, file restored after)</summary>

```
A1  drop `await ahead;` (the send no longer waits for the turn ahead)
    × a turn sent during a slow upload reaches the agent after the turn carrying the upload
      AssertionError: expected 2 to be 1
    Tests  1 failed | 2 passed (3)
A2  isLoading={isLoading || preparingTurn} -> isLoading={isLoading}
    × a turn sent during a slow upload …   AssertionError: expected false to be true
    × an upload that fails releases the busy state …   AssertionError: expected false to be true
    Tests  2 failed | 1 passed (3)
```

The CONTROL stays green under both, as it should.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- During an upload the pane's `isLoading` is true, so `ChatbotEnhanced` shows its thinking row, locks the plan card's actions and draws the submit button as Stop. The page passes `onStop` only for a real reply, so Stop does nothing while a turn uploads (cancelling an upload is not in this card). Locking the plan actions is wanted: a plan click is a send too, and would otherwise overtake the uploading turn the same way.
- A send that reaches the page directly (a suggestion click, a plan action) while a turn is being prepared waits in the page's chain and is handed to `sendMessage` right after that turn, not after its reply; typed messages go through the composer's queue and wait for the reply. Both arrive in the order sent, which is the card's acceptance.
- #34461 (the attachment notes follow the conversation's language) edits the same `prepareTurn` code and is claimed after this PR lands (serial, same function).
